notes.title: DEMO version has been updated to v0.8.7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/b1869298e78619ff7ca11784b75a7d714b6583a4.png[/img]
Based on feedback from some players about performance and other issues to make an emergency update, the features of this update are as follows:
1.Adjust the rendering settings -- global reflections are only enabled at the most advanced level
2.Anomaly cube removal - bug fix
3.Fix the draw animation for all bows -- animation patching
El juego se encuentra actualmente a un 30% de progreso en general, estamos puliendo la sensación de la acción y añadiendo constantemente nuevos contenidos.
5.Slowing down the passage of time - reducing performance overhead

notes.title: DEMO Version Updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41468428/b1869298e78619ff7ca11784b75a7d714b6583a4.png[/img]
After a break due to the flu, production resumed on the new version. We have also updated the DEMO version, which has the following features.
1.DEMO package size reduction - 42% smaller than the first version
2.Archery dead spots are now removed - improving the smoothness of the game
3.New aiming collimation model replaces decals - easy to identify collimation
4.There is now a clear cue before the enemy comes - this cue is added after the countdown ends
5.Terrain, path adjustment - terrain is much better than before
6.Enemy count adjustment - slight difficulty pacing adjustment
7.Fixed auto-attack when God's Gift is selected - bug routine fix
8.SSGI\RTXGI support - for Nvidia 10-series or higher graphics cards, DX12 computers with rendering cranked up to enable GI functionality
